change: luismc-artifacts 1.0.0 released (#18). dev-standards now keeps these artifacts with the plugin: the record converted (AR17), the interim generator retired. Two secret-scan fixes followed on main (AR19, DS16).
AR7 and AR15 done and joined; every part of the plugin is on AR12-integration. AR17 added: dev-standards moves onto the plugin as the real-repo test. Release now expected about 15:30.

AR8, AR10 and AR11 done and joined. ARTIFACTSPEC settled what the agents asked: content edited through a folder (export-content, edit-content --from), design set, project prefixes, the pending JSON, the marketplace name, the hooks as built.
AR6 done and joined; ARTIFACTSPEC says the full-progress artifact’s section 1 is generated and allows the template’s theme script (R5.6, R5.9). AR9 to AR11 started.
AR5 done: ARTIFACTSPEC 1.0.0 committed to AR12-integration with the shared queue module; AR6, AR7, AR8 and AR15 started.

Expected times are now a date and a time on the owner’s clock (AS11, R6). Decisions 7 to 9: luismc-project-setup installs the plugin, which also installs on its own; the owner’s time zone per project; dev-standards names and changes no other project, so AR1 and AR13 are out of this list. The build runs from about 13:30 and merges on green.

The repo becomes the record: docs/artifacts/ holds the manifest, the task registry, each artifact’s content and last published HTML, committed to the default branch as docs-only commits; a deleted artifact is recreated from it without duplicates (AS19, AS20, AR15). dev-standards’ record saved (AR16). Model and effort profiles split into their own feature artifact.

Decisions answered (AR4): one task registry, task-ID branch names, catch-up at session start, an App / service column on the full-progress artifact. The look now comes from each project’s own design, with a plugin default for projects without one; dev-standards uses the default design (AR14), applied to this artifact.

Moved to dev-standards, where it is built. Rewritten to the agreed design: plugin luismc-artifacts; explicit names (feature artifact, full-progress artifact); the full-progress artifact shows all project work and is created with the first feature artifact; one task registry with automatic updates and hooks; task IDs AR1 to AR13; the review findings (section 7); five open decisions. Full Progress: dev-standards created.
Created as a proposal, after the owner asked for one template, numbered sections, Feature and Full Progress pages, and a dev-standards version.
